Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Media buyer for B2B SaaS
Looking for PPC ad expert / media buyer to help us determine our digital advertising focus. Looking for someone that can help us spend $10,000 in ads across multiple platforms and determine what is the best way for us to grow. We have mixed results doing Google/Bing/Youtube ads, and poor results in Facebook ads. Based on our current data we know there are more opportunities out there to explore.
</job>

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Home goods storefront rebuild (p03).

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full stack developer with extensive experience helping businesses improve their web presence and performance.

In my work on a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. That project improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months.

While my background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and related front-end and back-end work, I’m comfortable digging into data, testing approaches, and helping identify where growth opportunities are strongest. I’d be glad to help you evaluate your current ad performance across platforms and determine the best path to scale your $10,000 spend.
